meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 给选定的智能体组装上无需 API 密钥的 Tavily 远程工具,提供网络搜索和网页内容提取;免费额度用尽时,Claude 会引导你走付费密钥升级,且不会看到密钥本身。
howto.when: 当你说要安装无需 API 密钥的 Tavily 网络搜索、网址提取,或给 NanoClaw 智能体组配置这类工具时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Tavily 搜索和提取装到我的智能体组,不用 API 密钥。
say.note: 技能会先检查环境并询问具体组。

say.text: 给 group-1 注册无密钥的 Tavily 搜索和提取,并重启验证。
say.note: 会执行注册、重启并确认工具可用。

say.text: Tavily 免费额度用完了,帮我走密钥升级。
say.note: 会引导你在 OneCLI 创建密钥并重新注册。

howto.what_en: Installs Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools on selected agent groups; when the free allowance runs out, Claude walks the user through the paid-key upgrade without ever seeing the key.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key, or to configure such tools for NanoClaw agent groups.

say_en.text: Add Tavily Search and Extract to my agent groups without an API key.
say_en.note: Runs pre-flight and asks which groups to use.

say_en.text: Register keyless Tavily for group-1, then restart and verify.
say_en.note: Registers, restarts, and checks the tools.

say_en.text: My Tavily free allowance is exhausted; help me upgrade.
say_en.note: Walks you through creating a key in OneCLI.
